timeline.tweet: Discovering I’m genderfluid has been a wild ride. I hope that I may help others understand that we’re not a joke, we’re not confused, and that we’re not seeking attention. #Genderfluid #Nonbinary, and #Agender are all valid.

Oh my god you’re from Utah too?! Shit this place sucks. I’m going to the rally on Monday because I voted for the first time this midterms and now the damn church wants to go back on the votes. It’s infuriating.

There are female role models, there are male role models, there are trans role models and there are nonbinary role models that aren’t acknowledged. Just because your cis straight male mind can’t see beyond your penis does not mean you know my gender.

I accept and appreciate many of my feminine qualities but I also can’t ignore many of my masculine qualities. They are both parts of what makes me, me. I live by balance, I live by yin and yang, I live fluidly amongst both genders.

I am not cis and never have been. Ever since I was a child I could feel that I was both genders. I didn’t have the vocabulary or understanding to express it back then but now I know that I’m not the only one who experiences being nonbinary.
Finally evolving into my genderfluid, androgynous, shojo bishounen, dapper rococo form.

Well I believe I’m finally figuring out what my gender expression is. I thought I did but now I’m finally understanding that I’m more comfortable in masculine clothing than dresses. I was trying to go back and forth between the two.

I may wear skirts occasionally or even a dress on a very feminine day but the more I’ve been dressing in dapper masculine clothing the more I understand how much I’ve been wanting this my entire life.
That is to say I don’t want to be completely male. I don’t feel like a man. Just a very femme boy. Because I still love cute pastel things, flowers, and so forth.
AAAAAAAHHHHH I am so excited to move!!!!!!!!
And now that I have an actual idea of the type of boy I really feel a kindred connection to I feel like I can finally move forward again exploring my gender.

I’ve always known I’m not a girl and I know that I’m definitely not going to ever be a man... So I’ve been struggling figuring out where the hell I fit. Well I’m a soft boi. A dramatic, sometimes feminine, boy that loves nature and the finer things in life.
I’m seriously in love with the best man ever
So looking at everything with this new perspective I’m just appalled at how everything makes sense now. Thought I was crazy but actually it’s just my gender. 😬
Guys I’m seriously so sad. I want to celebrate Easter this year but I’m a weekend away from moving and have to focus on that. Easter is seriously my absolute favorite holiday too. 😭😭😭
........Well guess it’s time to move to Canada. Fuck this shit
So ready to move into my new place like god damn

I love my best friend from high school/college. Both times I’ve come out with my sexuality and then my gender she’s been so supportive, she’s also religious. She’s just amazing and makes me feel safe, valid, and supported. ❤️🧡💛💚💙

I’ve been going through a few months exploring my gender and identifying with #nonbinary #genderfluid #genderqueer but none of them fit me. I am not discrediting those who identify as such and I appreciate that there are nb people out there.

But at the end of the day I can’t deny that I want a fully functioning male body. I want top and bottom surgery. I want to get on T. I want to do all of these things because I have dysphoria bad. I despise my female body so much.

But I was scared to admit that I feel 100% male.... Well perhaps not 100% because I’m still gender non conforming. I like classically “feminine” things, I’m definitely more feminine in action which is why I was confused and identifying with nonbinary.

I can no longer accept it. I tried to enjoy my “womanhood”. I went through a phase where I became hyper feminine. Trying to be the “perfect woman”. My friends all say now that they feel like I was overcompensating. I understand now I was.

I tried to love my female body. It’s not a bad body. If it was on another woman I could see myself making love to her and cherishing her. It’s a nice body..... but it’s not the right body for me. It can never be.

To be honest I was scared it wasn’t going to work between us because he was so taken aback by it but now that he’s given it thought and supporting me I feel like I’m falling in love again. ❤️🧡💛💚💙💜 #ftm #trans

I’m going to start practicing self love, self care, taking care of my body and directing it in the direction I will feel better in my own skin. I’m going to be more aware of my mental health. I’m going to allow myself to be spiritual. I will do my best and my best may vary.

I’m turning 24 and I’ve decided it’s time for me to fully live as my true self. I’m going to live the life that will make me happy. I’m going to live for me and only me. I love my friends and family but only I know what’s going to make me happy.

Thinking back three years ago to the #Pulse Florida shooting I’m actually baffled at how much it affected me and my life..... Three years ago I was a closeted pansexual trans man that was trying to be a good little Mormon girl.....

I was depressed, dealing with major anxiety attacks, ptsd, and living as a hermit in my parent’s basement. I was 21 and my life felt like a disaster. I felt like a complete and utter failure. I dropped out of college and I was sent home early from my Mormon mission.

I still have a long ways to go but I’m feeling better being myself than I ever have before. Now I’m trying to help fight back against homophobia and transphobia that is rife in this country. I want a future where tragedies like #Pulse never happen again.
So coming out as trans has been great. Especially now when random ass cis straight men dm me I can just be like “heh, guess what bro, you gay!” It’s honestly so satisfying 😂
Heh thank the Devil I’m not Christian anymore because my life was fucking boring.

At some point in my transition journey I plan on having a penis themed party. You know how at sex shops they have a million penis shaped things for bridal showers? Well I’m going to get all that stuff for my penis shower because I’m a tacky boy. 😬

♥️Tomorrow is mine and James’s 3 year anniversary. It’s honestly been a wild ride. He’s helped me through three moves 🥵 I’ve helped him through a move. He was there for me throughout a year I had four family members…

I’m proud to see our stories finally being told in cinema. I’m proud to be a pansexual trans man that loves his boyfriend very much. I am proud to say that times are changing for the better. I’m proud of all of us. 🏳️‍🌈 #LGBTQtogether #LGBTQtakeover #LGBTQ
